en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Al Hassan Bin Ali, from Musna Bin Abdul Salaam, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The one in Ihraam cannot get cupping done unless if he fears upon himself, or unable to Pray’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from al-Hassan ibn Ali from Muthanna’ ibn ‘Abd al-Salam from Zurarah who has said the following: “Abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
One in the state of Ihram, must not use cupping (draw blood from one’s body) unless one fears for his life and that one cannot perform Salat (prayer).”’
